question: What attainments make a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment is named as an attainment.
Liberation is named as an attainment.
Great accomplishment is named as an attainment.
Possessing these makes one dear to the yoginīs.
inference: A practitioner who attains enjoyment, liberation, and great accomplishment becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: One may become dear to the yoginīs through enjoyment, liberation, and great accomplishment.
